info.title: FABINZI Customer API v1
info.summary: Frozen first-party Customer mobile API contract derived from FABINZI WEB v1.0.
info.description: Only /api/v1/customer/ public discovery and Customer-authenticated routes are in this contract. Designer, Manufacturer, /Maneg/, operations, finance, admin, and payment webhooks are excluded.

servers.description: Same-origin API base. Production requires HTTPS.
